description: This file defines the StatelessWorkerPlacement class, which implements a placement strategy for stateless worker grains in Orleans. It manages configuration such as maximum local instances and whether idle workers should be removed proactively.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerPlacement
classes.description: Implements a placement strategy for stateless worker grains, allowing multiple instances and configurable idle worker removal.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the placement configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the placement with grain properties, parsing configuration values for MaxLocal and RemoveIdleWorkers.

methods.name: PopulateGrainProperties
methods.description: Populates grain properties with current placement settings, for configuration or serialization purposes.
